## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `hubspot-crm-obj-contacts-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a HubSpot private app

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your HubSpot account. -->
2. Select **Settings** gear icon in the top navigation bar.
3. <!-- manual: In the left sidebar, navigate to Integrations › Private Apps. -->
4. Select **Create a private app**.
5. <!-- manual: On the Basic Info tab, enter a name for your app (e.g., Ballerina CRM Contacts) and optionally a description and logo. -->

## Step 3: Configure required scopes

1. Select **Scopes**.
2. <!-- manual: Under CRM, find and select the following scopes: -->
3. <!-- manual: crm.objects.contacts.read: required to read contact records -->
4. <!-- manual: crm.objects.contacts.write: required to create, update, and delete contacts -->
5. <!-- manual: Add any additional scopes needed by your integration (e.g., crm.objects.companies.read for association lookups). -->

## Step 4: Create the app and copy the access token

1. Select **Create app** in the top-right corner.
2. Review the permissions summary in the confirmation dialog and click **Continue creating**.
3. After the app is created, HubSpot displays a **Token** dialog with your access token.
4. <!-- manual: Copy the access token; this is your token value for the connector's BearerTokenConfig. -->

## Step 5: Rotate or regenerate the access token (if needed)

1. <!-- manual: Go to Settings › Integrations › Private Apps. -->
2. <!-- manual: Click on your private app name. -->
3. <!-- manual: Under the Auth tab, click Rotate token to invalidate the existing token and generate a new one. -->
4. <!-- manual: Copy and store the new token securely, then update your integration configuration. -->
